page_title: ROM 2-0 CAG | AS Roma v Cagliari 09/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: El Shaarawy S. Achilles Tendon Injury

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+3' Matteo Marcenaro has a clear sight and sees a foul from Juan Rodriguez (Cagliari).
90+2' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Michel Adopo (Cagliari) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
90+1' AS Roma are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Riyad Idrissi (Cagliari) has tested the patience of referee Matteo Marcenaro and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
89' Lorenzo Venturino (AS Roma) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
88' Cagliari quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
87' Today's match ends for Gianluca Gaetano who will be replaced by Yael Trepy (Cagliari).
87' Fabio Pisacane has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) replacing Jose Pedro.
86' AS Roma take a short corner kick.
85' Lorenzo Venturino (AS Roma) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
84' Here comes a substitution. Donyell Malen is given a rest as he is replaced by Antonio Arena (AS Roma).
84' Gian Piero Gasperini decides to make a substitution. Matias Soule will be replaced by Lorenzo Venturino (AS Roma).
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Neil El Aynaoui (AS Roma) comes onto the pitch for Bryan Cristante.
83' Cagliari earn a free kick.
82' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Bryan Zaragoza (AS Roma) was quite harsh and Matteo Marcenaro didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
82' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
80' The game is interrupted now, Zeki Celik (AS Roma) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
79' Crossbar! Ibrahim Sulemana (Cagliari) picks up a precise pass and produces a bullet of a strike from distance that smashes against the crossbar. It could have been a brilliant goal.
78' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) attempts to create a scoring opportunity with a wonderful long ball, but his pass is blocked.
77' A pass from Bryan Zaragoza (AS Roma) is intercepted by Elia Caprile and the move breaks down.
75' Riyad Idrissi (Cagliari) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
74' Donyell Malen (AS Roma) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
73' Fabio Pisacane has decided to substitute Sebastiano Esposito and he is replaced by Riyad Idrissi (Cagliari).
73' It will be a substitution. Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) is ready to enter the pitch as Semih Kilicsoy walks off.
71' Bryan Zaragoza (AS Roma) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
70' A cross from Matias Soule (AS Roma) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.

69' Elia Caprile makes a brilliant save! Bryan Zaragoza (AS Roma) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from just outside of the box. His effort goes towards the bottom left corner but is saved by the keeper!
68' Bryan Zaragoza (AS Roma) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
65' 2 - 0 Donyell Malen (AS Roma) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and coolly sends the ball into the back of the net.
65' A pass from Bryan Zaragoza (AS Roma) is intercepted by Elia Caprile and the move breaks down.
64' Corner kicks – 6:0.
62' AS Roma work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
61' Matias Soule (AS Roma) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
61' Matteo Marcenaro shows a yellow card to Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) for his blatant foul.
59' Fabio Pisacane has decided to make a change. Ibrahim Sulemana (Cagliari) replaces Luca Mazzitelli.
58' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) picks up a yellow card.
58' Bryan Zaragoza (AS Roma) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
57' Substitution. Bryan Zaragoza (AS Roma) has come on for Lorenzo Pellegrini.
56' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle for a foul.
55' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
53' Donyell Malen (AS Roma) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
52' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
51' The linesman raises his flag. Donyell Malen (AS Roma) is adjudged offside.
50' Wesley Franca (AS Roma) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
49' Daniele Ghilardi (AS Roma) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
48' Luca Mazzitelli (Cagliari) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
44' Wesley Franca (AS Roma) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
43' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. It's a free kick to Cagliari in a dangerous position.
41' Daniele Ghilardi (AS Roma) rises above the defence inside the box, but his header flies narrowly wide of the left post.
40' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) has tested the patience of referee Matteo Marcenaro and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
39' Semih Kilicsoy (Cagliari) commits a rough foul. Matteo Marcenaro stops the game and makes a call.
37' Donyell Malen (AS Roma) plays a through ball but overhits it.
36' An accurate cross into the centre of the box from Bryan Cristante gives Donyell Malen (AS Roma) a clear sight of goal, but he sends his headed effort narrowly wide of the left post.
35' Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
34' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
33' Donyell Malen (AS Roma) is penalised for a foul. Matteo Marcenaro had a clear view and blows his whistle.
32' Donyell Malen (AS Roma) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
31' Mile Svilar makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded by Alberto Dossena (Cagliari) after a cross from the side.

30' The game is interrupted. Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. Cagliari win a free kick.
29' The ball is cleared after Donyell Malen (AS Roma) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
27' Semih Kilicsoy (Cagliari) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
25' 1 - 0 GOAL! Donyell Malen (AS Roma) collects a pass and from inside the box he lifts the ball over Elia Caprile, who was off his line. What a finish that is! 1:0.
23' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for AS Roma.
23' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Wesley Franca (AS Roma), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
22' Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant shot to the bottom left corner, but is thwarted by a great save from Elia Caprile.
20' Semih Kilicsoy (Cagliari) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Matteo Marcenaro blows for a foul.
19' Luca Mazzitelli (Cagliari) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle for a foul.
18' Matias Soule (AS Roma) is adjudged offside.
16' Matias Soule (AS Roma) races through the centre to the edge of the box then lets fly with a rocket of a shot that flies a whisker wide of the left post.
15' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Mile Svilar comes off his line to intercept.
14' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Zeki Celik (AS Roma) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
13' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Matteo Marcenaro blows for a foul.
11' A corner kick by AS Roma is thwarted by the well prepared Elia Caprile (Cagliari).
10' A lofted cross from Wesley Franca (AS Roma) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. AS Roma have been awarded a corner kick.
10' Corner kick. Matias Soule (AS Roma) is ready to send the ball into the box.
9' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.

9' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma have been awarded a corner kick.
8' Donyell Malen (AS Roma) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
6' Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) launches himself at the ball from the free kick and produces a header which lacks accuracy, sending it just over the bar.
5' Alberto Dossena (Cagliari) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Matteo Marcenaro had an easy-decision to make.
5' Donyell Malen (AS Roma) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Elia Caprile intercepts the ball.
4' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
2' Matias Soule (AS Roma) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
1' A quickly taken corner by AS Roma.

1' Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. AS Roma will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. AS Roma will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Matteo Marcenaro.
